description.zh:
实例的计费方式。更多详情，请参见[计费概览](~~25398~~)。取值范围： 

- PrePaid：包年包月。
- PostPaid：按量付费。

默认值：PostPaid。
description.en:
The billing method of the instance. For more information, see [Billing overview](~~25398~~). Valid values:

- PrePaid: subscription.
- PostPaid: pay-as-you-go.

Default value: PostPaid.

description.zh: 实例规格。取值请参见[实例规格族](~~25378~~)。
description.en: The instance type. For more information, see [Instance families](~~25378~~).

description.zh:
查询不同操作方式的公网带宽规格限制。取值范围： 

- Upgrade：升级公网带宽。
- Downgrade：降级公网带宽。
- Create：新建ECS实例。

默认值：Create。
description.en:
The operation type for querying public bandwidth limits. Valid values:

- Upgrade: upgrades the public bandwidth.
- Downgrade: downgrades the public bandwidth.
- Create: creates an ECS instance.

Default value: Create.

description.zh: 目标地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The ID of the target region. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
资源ID。

> 当您将参数OperationType设置为Upgrade或者Downgrade时，参数ResourceId为必选参数。
description.en:
The resource ID.

> When you set the OperationType parameter to Upgrade or Downgrade, the ResourceId parameter is required.

description.zh:
按量付费实例的抢占策略。取值范围： 

- NoSpot：正常按量付费实例。
- SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式实例。
- SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，最高按量付费价格。

默认值：NoSpot。

>当参数InstanceChargeType取值为PostPaid时，参数SpotStrategy才有效。
description.en:
The bidding strategy for pay-as-you-go instances. Valid values:

- NoSpot: a regular pay-as-you-go instance.
- SpotWithPriceLimit: a preemptible instance with a user-defined maximum hourly price.
- SpotAsPriceGo: a preemptible instance priced at the market price at the time of purchase.

Default value: NoSpot.

> The SpotStrategy parameter takes effect only when the InstanceChargeType parameter is set to PostPaid.

title.zh: 查询不同实例规格公网带宽上限
title.en: Query the maximum public bandwidth for different instance types

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-bandwidth-limitation --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-charge-type PostPaid --spot-strategy NoSpot --instance-type ecs.g5.large --resource-id i-bp67acfmxazb4ph000 --operation-type Upgrade --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs DescribeBandwidthLimitation --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId 'i-bp67acfmxazb4ph000' --InstanceChargeType PostPaid --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --OperationType Upgrade --InstanceType 'ecs.g5.large' --SpotStrategy NoSpot
